gen-fs-expose-gf-oxygen: Expose packs its striking capitals into a tight, compressed rhythm with almost no gap between lowercase and caps. Oxygen answers with open curves and lowercase that nearly matches its capitals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-radio-canada-big: Refined and striking up top, Expose runs tight. Radio Canada Big takes over below with a monoline plain sans, its tall x-height filling each line while terminals stay clear of the stems.
gen-fs-expose-gf-readex-pro: Tight, sharp, a little glamorous. Expose compresses its rhythm hard, while Readex Pro keeps a single stroke width in every glyph and leaves broad gaps at each terminal.
gen-fs-expose-gf-roboto: Roboto is the quiet partner here, with generous mouths on its round letters. Expose does best at compressed, striking display size; Roboto does best at carrying text with a low contrast between capital and body height.
gen-fs-expose-gf-saira: Expose arrives tight and striking, with barely a pause between letters. Saira follows with rounded forms stretching high toward the top line and an s you can see through, which loosens the page.
gen-fs-expose-gf-sen: Compressed, refined, a little theatrical. Sen takes the body job with tall lowercase and a plain stripe of constant ink, while Expose is the one built for display impact.
gen-fs-expose-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans reads modern and tidy, its rounded letters open at the side and its tall lowercase cut like acrylic stencil pieces. And Expose sits above with refined, compressed capitals, giving the page a tight top and an open lower half.
gen-fs-expose-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condens: Striking is the first word for Expose, with its compressed cadence and barely any pause. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed reads steadily after it, lowercase nearly matching the capitals and horizontals no thinner than the verticals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-stack-sans-text: Expose delivers refined, compressed display lettering with barely any gap between x-height and caps, while Stack Sans Text draws one marker-like line throughout. One is built to strike; the other to carry text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-ubuntu-sans: Modern is the mood of Ubuntu Sans, with big lowercase eyes and tubular strokes like bent copper pipe. And Expose above it stays striking and compressed, so the text underneath feels roomier by comparison.
